tools.name: show_inspection
tools.description: Returns an MCP App card for a restaurant name, or a map for a violation term in a city. Hosts that support MCP Apps render the card or map inline. The text result names the matches for hosts that only show text.

tools.name: get_milwaukee_inspections
tools.description: Returns an MCP App card ranking Milwaukee restaurants with the most serious recent health-inspection violations. The server ranks a wide recent window and returns one page of that ranking. Supports limit/offset pagination.

tools.name: get_city_inspections
tools.description: Returns an MCP App card ranking restaurants with the most serious recent health-inspection violations in the chosen city (chicago, nyc, minneapolis, milwaukee, austin, denver). The server ranks a wide recent window and returns one page of that ranking. Supports limit/offset pagination.

tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Looks up restaurants by name, including partial names and imperfect spelling, and returns an MCP App card for each match. An optional city argument limits the search to one city.

tools.name: find_nearby_restaurants
tools.description: Returns an MCP App card of restaurants near a point or address. The default radius is a quarter mile.
